title: Migrate from Freshdesk to Unthread: Step-by-Step Freshdesk Migration Guide
summary: Move from Freshdesk to Unthread with this step-by-step guide covering data transfer, setup, integrations, and configuration.
body_markdown:
When internal support teams outgrow Freshdesk, the underlying problem is rarely about features. It is about architecture. Freshdesk was built for external customer support, with portals, email queues, and phone integrations designed for customers who do not work inside your organization. For IT, HR, Finance, and Legal teams supporting employees who live in Slack all day, that architecture creates constant friction.


The migration from Freshdesk to[Slack-native help desk](https://unthread.io/products/slack-support?ref=unthread.io) is not just a platform switch. It is a fundamental shift from portal-based ticketing to conversational support that meets employees where they already work.


This guide walks through the complete migration process, from evaluating whether Unthread fits your needs to configuring automations that resolve requests without human intervention.


## **Key Takeaways**


- Portal-first help desk software forces employees out of their workflow and into separate ticketing systems, creating friction that slows resolution times and frustrates internal teams across IT, HR, Finance, and Legal departments
- Slack-native architecture eliminates context-switching entirely by turning the channels where employees already work into structured help desks with full ticketing, SLAs, and automation capabilities
- Purpose-built AI agents can[resolve 40% automatically](https://unthread.io/blog/case-study-how-lemonade-boosts-efficiency-with-unthread-and-gen-ai/) without per-resolution fees or session limits, freeing internal support teams to focus on complex requests
- Migration from Freshdesk to a Slack-native platform takes days rather than months because employees already know how to use Slack, reducing training overhead and accelerating time to value
- Self-learning knowledge bases generate documentation automatically from resolved tickets, reducing the manual content creation burden that keeps traditional help desk knowledge bases outdated
- Bring-your-own-LLM capabilities provide data sovereignty for regulated industries that cannot send sensitive employee data to third-party AI models


## **Why Modern Teams Are Moving Beyond Traditional Help Desk Software**


Traditional help desk software operates on a simple assumption: employees will leave their work environment, navigate to a separate portal, and submit a structured ticket when they need help. That assumption breaks down in Slack-first organizations where employees spend their entire workday in channels, DMs, and threads.


### **The Limitations of Portal-First Platforms**


- Context-switching kills productivity when employees must open a browser, log into a portal, and fill out forms instead of asking a quick question in Slack
- Ticket creation becomes a barrier that leads employees to message IT or HR directly in DMs, creating shadow queues with no tracking or accountability
- Portal-based systems were designed for external customers who expect formal ticket submission processes, not employees who want fast answers
- Traditional automations require technical configuration that most HR or Finance teams cannot manage without engineering support


The rise of conversational interfaces reflects how modern employees actually prefer to communicate. When someone needs to reset a password, request software access, or ask about parental leave policies, they want to type a quick message in Slack and get an answer. Forcing them through a portal adds friction that portal-first help desks cannot eliminate.


Freshdesk offers Slack integrations, but integrations are fundamentally different from native architecture. An integration sends notifications to Slack. A Slack-native platform turns Slack channels into the help desk itself, with tickets living in threads where conversations happen naturally.


## **Evaluating Your Needs: Is Unthread the Right Freshdesk Alternative?**


Not every organization should migrate from Freshdesk. Teams running external B2C customer support operations with phone queues, social media intake, and multi-brand portal requirements may find Freshdesk's feature set better aligned with their needs.


### **When Unthread Is Right**


Unthread is the right[Freshdesk alternative](https://unthread.io/blog/freshdesk-alternatives) when:


- Your internal support teams use Slack as their primary communication tool and employees expect to get help without leaving their workspace
- You need multi-department support coverage across IT, HR, Finance, Legal, and Procurement from a single platform
- Ticket volume is high enough that[AI automation delivering 40%](https://unthread.io/blog/case-study-how-lemonade-boosts-efficiency-with-unthread-and-gen-ai/) auto-resolution would meaningfully reduce manual workload
- Your team lacks engineering resources to configure complex automations and wants natural language workflow creation
- Data sovereignty matters for sensitive employee requests involving payroll, benefits, or performance issues


### **When Unthread May Not Fit**


Unthread may not be the right fit when:


- External customer support via phone, social media, or multi-brand portals is your primary use case
- Your organization does not use Slack as its primary internal communication tool
- Budget constraints prioritize lowest possible entry price over Slack-native capabilities


The core differentiator is architectural. Freshdesk was designed in 2010 when email-based ticketing dominated internal support. Unthread was built specifically for Slack-first organizations, with conversational ticketing as the foundation rather than an add-on feature.


## **Planning Your Helpdesk Migration: From Freshdesk to Unthread**


Successful migrations require planning beyond technical data transfer. The strategic decisions you make before exporting a single ticket determine whether your team realizes the full benefits of Slack-native support.


### **Define Migration Scope**


- Identify which departments will migrate first to pilot the platform before full rollout
- Decide whether to migrate historical ticket data or start fresh with new conversations
- Map your existing Freshdesk workflows to understand which automations need recreation
- Determine your SLA requirements so you can configure them immediately in the new system
- Plan your parallel operation period when both systems run simultaneously


### **Data Preparation Checklist**


- Export ticket history including status, priority, assignee, and resolution notes
- Export customer/employee contact information and any custom fields
- Document your current automation rules and triggers
- Export knowledge base articles for re-import or AI training
- Identify integrations that need reconfiguration (Jira, Salesforce, HRIS systems)


Migration from Freshdesk to a Slack-native platform takes days rather than months for teams using API-based export and Unthread's bidirectional sync capabilities.


## **Step-by-Step: Exporting Data from Your Freshdesk Ticketing System**


Freshdesk provides multiple export options depending on your plan level and data volume requirements. Understanding these options helps you choose the approach that preserves the most valuable historical context.


### **Accessing Freshdesk Exports**


- Navigate to Admin > Account > Export Data for bulk ticket exports
- Use the Freshdesk API for programmatic extraction with custom field mapping
- Export knowledge base articles separately through the Solutions section
- Download agent performance reports if you want historical analytics


### **Ensuring Data Completeness**


- Ticket data should include full conversation threads, internal notes, custom field values, and attachment references
- Contact records need email addresses, names, and any custom properties you use for routing
- SLA configurations should be documented manually since they export as policies, not data
- Automation rules require manual documentation or API extraction


For organizations with complex data migration requirements, working with Unthread's solutions engineering team ensures proper field mapping and validation before going live.


## **Seamless Onboarding: Importing Your Data into Unthread's Ticketing System**


Unthread's import process differs from traditional help desk migrations because the platform is designed around Slack channels rather than portal-based ticket queues. This architectural difference simplifies setup while requiring different configuration decisions.


### **Configuring Slack Channels**


Rather than importing tickets into a separate system, Unthread turns your existing Slack channels into structured help desks. A channel like #it-help becomes your IT service desk intake point, with every message automatically tracked as a ticket. Some ticket types remain visible in-channel for collaborative resolution, while sensitive requests route to private DM flows.


### **Mapping Freshdesk Data**


- Historical tickets can import via API for reference and reporting continuity
- User records sync automatically through Slack workspace membership
- Custom fields map to Unthread properties for consistent categorization
- Knowledge base content imports directly or syncs from Google Drive, Notion, or Confluence


### **Post-Migration Verification Steps**


- Confirm all active tickets transferred with correct status and assignment
- Test automation triggers to ensure workflows fire correctly
- Validate SLA calculations against your defined business hours
- Verify[integrations with tools](https://unthread.io/products/integrations?ref=unthread.io) like Jira, Salesforce, and HRIS systems


The Enterprise plan includes a[dedicated solutions engineer](https://unthread.io/pricing?ref=unthread.io) who assists with migration and data validation, reducing the burden on your internal team.


## **Setting Up Your Unthread Help Desk: Maximizing AI and Automation**


Configuration in Unthread focuses on teaching the system how your team works rather than building complex rule trees. The purpose-built AI agent learns from your knowledge base and resolved tickets to handle routine requests automatically.


### **Configuring Conversational Ticketing**


- Designate intake channels where employee requests create tickets automatically
- Set up private flows for HR so sensitive requests about payroll, benefits, or employee relations stay confidential
- Configure routing rules that assign tickets based on content analysis, employee department, or request type
- Define escalation paths for requests that need manager approval or cross-team collaboration


### **Building Automations Naturally**


Unlike traditional help desks requiring technical rule configuration, Unthread's[automation builder](https://unthread.io/products/automations?ref=unthread.io) accepts plain English descriptions. Tell it "When someone asks about password reset, send them the self-service reset link and mark resolved" and the system creates the workflow. This approach lets HR and Finance teams build their own automations without engineering dependencies.


### **Integrating Existing Tools**


- Jira integration creates linked tickets for bug reports that need engineering attention
- Salesforce and HubSpot connections pull account context for revenue operations teams
- HRIS integration enables automated employee onboarding and offboarding workflows
- Okta and Microsoft 365 provide identity management for access request automation


Initial setup typically completes in days rather than the weeks or months required for traditional ITSM platforms, because employees already know how to use Slack.


## **Beyond the Basics: Leveraging Unthread's AI for Superior Internal Support**


The purpose-built AI agent in Unthread goes beyond chatbot-style deflection. It understands request intent, references your knowledge base, drafts accurate responses, and resolves tickets end-to-end when appropriate.


### **How Agentic AI Delivers Results**


Lemonade deployed Unthread across IT, HR, Legal, Procurement, and Finance teams, achieving[40% automatic resolution](https://unthread.io/blog/case-study-how-lemonade-boosts-efficiency-with-unthread-and-gen-ai/) without per-resolution fees or session limits. Unlike solutions that mainly automate access requests, Unthread's AI spans multiple Tier 1 internal support workflows including:


- Password resets and MFA issues
- Software access and license requests
- HR policy questions and benefits inquiries
- Equipment requests and workspace reservations
- Expense policy clarifications and approval workflows


### **Self-Learning Knowledge Base**


The[knowledge base](https://unthread.io/products/knowledge-base?ref=unthread.io) automatically detects repeated questions from ticket patterns and generates draft documentation. When employees keep asking "How do I expense international travel?" the system identifies the gap and drafts an article for one-click approval. This approach keeps documentation current without manual content creation overhead.


### **Measuring AI Effectiveness**


- Track AI deflection rate as percentage of tickets resolved without human intervention
- Monitor CSAT scores specifically for AI-resolved versus human-resolved tickets
- Analyze which ticket categories have highest and lowest auto-resolution rates
- Use gap analysis to identify documentation needs driving failed deflections


Sisense's IT team achieved[99% CSAT](https://unthread.io/blog/case-study-how-sisenses-it-team-achieved-99-csat-with-unthread/) using Unthread's AI to manage SLAs and auto-resolve routine requests from their knowledge base.


## **Unifying Communication: Why Unthread Excels for Multi-Channel Internal Support**


Internal support teams often manage requests from multiple sources: Slack channels, direct messages, forwarded emails, and requests that come through during meetings. Unifying these channels into a single system eliminates the tracking gaps that create shadow queues.


### **Breaking Down Silos**


- Email-to-Slack conversion turns forwarded support emails into Slack threads with private team discussion
- Microsoft Teams support extends coverage for organizations using multiple collaboration platforms
- Customer portal integration provides self-service options for employees who prefer browser-based submission
- Omni-channel inbox shows all open requests regardless of intake source


### **Why Slack-Native Beats Integrations**


Zendesk and Zoho Desk offer Slack integrations that send notifications when tickets update. Unthread is fundamentally different because[Slack IS the desk](https://unthread.io/blog/zendesk-vs-unthread) , not a notification layer. Agents respond in Slack threads. Employees see updates in real-time. The entire conversation happens where work already occurs.


### **Centralized Visibility**


IT teams supporting global employees across time zones benefit from unified queues that show ticket status, SLA countdown, and assignment regardless of which channel originated the request. The[shared inbox](https://unthread.io/products/shared-inbox?ref=unthread.io) provides this visibility without requiring agents to check multiple systems.


## **Scaling Your Operations: Unthread for Enterprise Ticketing Systems**


Enterprise organizations require security, compliance, and administrative capabilities that go beyond basic ticketing. Unthread's Enterprise tier addresses these requirements while maintaining the simplicity that makes Slack-native support effective.


### **Meeting Enterprise Requirements**


- SOC2 Type II compliance with regular independent security audits
- HIPAA compliance with BAAs for healthcare organizations handling protected health information
- SSO integration with enterprise identity providers
- SCIM sync for automated user provisioning and deprovisioning


### **Data Sovereignty**


Unthread provides bring-your-own-LLM capabilities for organizations that cannot send sensitive employee data to third-party AI models. This capability lets regulated industries use internal GPT instances while maintaining full AI automation benefits.


### **Supporting Complex Structures**


- Multi-team organization support with custom settings and permissions per department
- Cross-team ticket sharing for requests requiring collaboration across IT, HR, and Finance
- On-call rotation management with workload distribution based on availability
- Private knowledge bases for departments with confidential documentation needs


Enterprise deployment includes dedicated hosting options and industry-leading SLA guarantees for organizations requiring isolated environments.

## **Frequently Asked Questions**


### **What happens to our existing Freshdesk integrations when we migrate to Unthread?**


Unthread maintains integrations with the same enterprise tools Freshdesk connects to, including Jira, Salesforce, HubSpot, ServiceNow, and major HRIS platforms. The migration process includes mapping your existing integration workflows to Unthread's connector system. For tools without native integration, Unthread's API and Zapier connection extend compatibility to thousands of additional applications. Your solutions engineer reviews each integration during migration planning to ensure no workflow gaps exist before cutover.


### **Can we run Freshdesk and Unthread simultaneously during the transition period?**


Yes, bidirectional sync capabilities allow parallel operation where tickets created in either system stay synchronized. This approach lets teams pilot Unthread with specific departments or request types while maintaining Freshdesk for other workflows. Most organizations run parallel systems for two to four weeks before completing full migration. The sync ensures no requests fall through cracks during the transition and provides rollback capability if unexpected issues arise.


### **How does Unthread handle private HR requests that employees do not want visible in shared Slack channels?**


Unthread supports private DM-based ticketing specifically designed for sensitive HR requests. Employees can submit tickets through direct message to an HR bot or designated HR contact, with the conversation remaining private while still tracking in the HR team's unified queue. This approach handles confidential matters like payroll discrepancies, parental leave requests, employee relations issues, and benefits questions without exposing details in public channels. HR teams see full ticket history and can collaborate internally without the employee seeing those discussions.


### **What is the total cost difference between Freshdesk and Unthread over three years for a mid-sized team?**


Unthread's Pro plan includes AI automation without the per-session fees common with other platforms, which can lead to more predictable costs and a lower total cost of ownership over time.


### **Does migrating to Unthread require retraining our entire support team?**


Minimal training is required because employees and agents already know how to use Slack. The interface change from portal-based ticketing to conversational threads is intuitive for teams accustomed to Slack communication. Most organizations complete agent training in one to two hours covering ticket management shortcuts, automation builder basics, and reporting dashboards. Employee training is often unnecessary since submitting a request simply means sending a message in a designated Slack channel, which they already do informally.
